goal.label: Goal
goal.text: a family where every child is pale
goal.next: Next: Pip with Moss, pale 1 in 2
reason.moss.markings: Pip shows pale. Reed gave Pip one pale copy, so Moss gave the other.
chain.text: Pip hatched pale, so Moss hides pale; Tita has none, so it came from Bramble.
clues.title: Clues
clue.wild.title: Met, no family yet
first.card.title: Whisker from Bramble
first.card.how: Bramble ate from your hand at the pond's edge.
first.card.when: Found 5 min into your first expedition. The Companion sent it home.
first.card.ready: The bench can study it now: ready in 2 min.
ask.title: What should the whisker tell you?
ask.sub: One question. The whisker is used up; the answer stays.
ask.crown: Crown: what hides under Bramble's leaf crest?
ask.eyes: Eyes: how far Bramble's eye rings can run
ask.drive: Drive: how bursty Bramble is, exactly
ask.drive.kind: a track tells this, not a whisker
answer.title: The whisker's answer
answer.text: Under Bramble's leaf crest: a bare copy.
answer.spread: Tita has a bare head, so two bare copies. A child of Tita and Bramble: bare head 1 in 2, and every crested one hides bare.
answer.first: First ink: 7 min after you started
answer.pair: If Tita and Bramble had a child
home.title: Sorrel climbed the log pile in short bursts, resting between each.
home.first: The first time Sorrel climbed at your place
home.ink: Bursts. Seen at home, the first time.
home.full: Sorrel is fully known: every trait in ink.
home.why: No sample or cross needed: what Sorrel did showed it.
cross.b.tag: Met today at the brook bank, in rain.
cross.tell.title: What this cross could tell you
cross.tell.pale: A pale child: proves Wren hides pale. Your second pale one: the goal's last step.
cross.tell.plain: A plain child: hides pale for sure; Wren's odds drop.
cross.tell.bare: A bare-headed child: proves Reed hides bare.
cross.tell.eyes: Any child: narrows where Wren's eye rings can run.
